title: 413 करोड़ में से 103 करोड़ वसूले गए: CAG रिपोर्ट
description:
भारत के संवैधानिक ऑडिटर CAG की रिपोर्ट "Adding Value to Public Governance 2025-26" पर Business Standard की रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक़, ऑडिट के बाद ₹4,251.34 करोड़ की वसूली हुई। मध्य प्रदेश के श्री सिंगाजी थर्मल पावर प्रोजेक्ट में बताए गए ₹413.25 करोड़ में से ₹103.64 करोड़, यानी करीब एक चौथाई, ठेकेदार से वसूले गए, जबकि BSNL में ₹47.69 करोड़ में से ₹42.71 करोड़, यानी लगभग 90 प्रतिशत। रिपोर्ट के अनुसार ऑडिट निष्कर्षों और नतीजों के बीच समय का अंतर आम है, और उसमें न वसूली गई कुल रकम का आँकड़ा नहीं दिया गया है।

Sources: Business Standard (29 अक्टूबर 2026); CAG रिपोर्ट "Adding Value to Public Governance 2025-26"

script:
ENGLISH SCRIPT (wording locked; system dubs to Hindi; target 55-58s; Hindi dub must stay under 60s, if over drop the Maharashtra sentence first)

ADITYA: An audit flagged ₹413 crore in damages not levied. ₹103 crore was recovered.
NISHA: This is from the CAG's report "Adding Value to Public Governance 2025-26". According to Business Standard, it was presented to the President in October.
ADITYA: According to Business Standard's reading of the report, recoveries worth ₹4,251.34 crore followed its audits. The largest single item, ₹3,389 crore, came from income-tax reassessments of banks and NBFCs.
NISHA: At the Shree Singaji thermal power project in Madhya Pradesh, ₹103.64 crore was recovered from the contractor, about a quarter of the ₹413.25 crore flagged.
ADITYA: In Maharashtra, ₹3.84 crore in duplicate Covid ex-gratia payments was flagged. By December 2024, ₹92.50 lakh had been recovered.
NISHA: Other cases recovered more. At BSNL, ₹42.71 crore of ₹47.69 crore, nearly 90 percent.
ADITYA: The report says it chose cases showing clear corrective action, and that "time lags between audit findings and observable outcomes are common." It gives no overall figure for unrecovered amounts.
NISHA: No government comment was found in the coverage. Should audit reports show that figure? Comment below.
